cls.quote: Experience effortless power with our thumb throttle. Choose to use throttle-only or pedal alongside. Ergonomic leatherette grips ensure a comfortable touch. | Maximum Speed ⟶ 20 MPH
cls.basis: maker states no class; thumb throttle and 20 mph -> 2

spd.quote: Though the 500-watt motor power can easily reach 20 miles per hour and the battery can get 35 miles of use out of a single charge, there is no reverse function, which could make it somewhat difficult to back into a parking space.

range.quote: Range ⟶ 45 Miles | 65 Miles with Pedal Assist
range.basis: FAQ: 'up to 45 miles on throttle alone and up to 65 miles with pedal assist'

load.basis: FAQ: 'supports up to 400 lbs total – rider plus cargo' (rider + cargo, not incl. trike)

motor.basis: spec table: Power 500W, Type DC Brushless, Brand Bafang; FAQ calls it 'a 500W Emojo brushless motor'

motor.quote: The Emojo Caddy Pro fat tire trike draws power from a 500W front hub motor, which can take the bike through dirt, mud, and uneven terrains.

fold.basis: rigid fat-tire trike frame; no folding mentioned

notes: Fat-tire electric trike. BikeBerry and RideReview (Gadget Review) both describe an older Caddy Pro spec (48V/15.6Ah, 35 mi range, 300 lb max user, 26in front tire, $3,839.95) vs maker's current 48V/15Ah 720Wh, 65 mi PAS, 400 lb, 24in front - so those sources are used only for unchanged specs (class, speed, weight, motor). Maker spec table says Bafang motor; FAQ says Emojo motor.
